decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit is core equipment for dental and hearing labs, sits close to the established offer, and kept its own page on the website for two years, so it looks well established.

The orthopedic shoe last is far from the core business, which raises the risk, but it was only launched in 2024, has its own page, and uses the firm's digital production know-how, so management would likely give it more time.
The post-curing unit supports the firm's digital and 3D-printing workflow and is close to the core offer, although so far it is only mentioned rather than featured on the website.
